user.title: Find measuring locations
user.description: Look for Rijkswaterstaat locations by name, or around a point on the map. A place without a sensor (a lake, a neighbourhood) works too: the nearest locations are offered.

menu_options.search_location: Search around a point on the map

search_name.title: Search by name
search_name.description: Enter the name of a Rijkswaterstaat location. If no location has that name, it is looked up as a place in the Netherlands (town, neighbourhood, lake...) and the nearest locations are offered.

data_description.query: For example Lobith, Maarssen or Nesselande.

search_location.title: Search around a point
search_location.description: Pick a point on the map. The nearest locations that reported a water temperature in the last 90 days are offered.

select.title: Select measuring locations
select.description: Locations that reported a water temperature in the last 90 days, nearest to {search} first.

data_description.locations: Each location becomes a device with a water temperature sensor.
data_description.quantities: Optional extra measurements to add for each location, when RWS publishes them there.

error.place_not_found: Could not find that place. Try another name or search around a point on the map.
error.no_stations: No location near there reported a water temperature in the last 90 days.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Rijkswaterstaat API.
abort.already_configured: Rijkswaterstaat is already configured. Use the options to change locations.
